name: fg-hudless-barrier
why: EXP-0176 single-variable step after the EXP-0171 control: hudless::prepare still recognises the pre-UI cut, but instead of returning 0 it submits one list of its own that only records back buffer RENDER_TARGET->COPY_SOURCE->RENDER_TARGET, so the one GPU-visible action added against the control is the barrier pair - no CopyResource, no hudless target, no published Frame. The barrier-only line is the world anchor (prepare declines outside a world) and must appear at least twice; the regex asks for the split, a size field and the format field separately on the same line, and the size is matched as a WxH pair with at least two digits on each side so a 0x... pointer cannot stand in for it. `inputs: ... skip=` twice plus `DLSS_G state ... result=0 mode=0` show presents and tokens still advancing while no hudless frame exists: because nothing is published in this round the inputs must keep skipping, and the skip reason is left generic. Deliberately not required: const=/tag= success, any evidence that a hudless frame was published or tagged, the F11 RTV/DSV inventory and any [vvsr] sr pick line, because the question is only whether the barrier pair alone is safe. Forbidden: the EXP-0151 copy path markers (copy path ready / copy split=), the word CopyResource on a hudless line, a valid inputs frame (size=WxH) - which cannot exist without a published copy - and the device-removal aftermath (0x887A002B, 0x887A0005, device removed, cmdQ.pacer, crash/panic/assert lines). The current probe line reads `[fg] hudless: probe-only split=45/48 buffer=0x1be08c00 index=1 size=2560x1440 fmt=28 swapchain=1`, so the barrier round is expected to read the same shape with barrier-only as the word. Trigger is a human step (launch, enter a world, stand still); a run that never enters a world reads ABORTED because the barrier line is world-only. dwell_s keeps reading 10 s past the first match so the absence assertions see frames after the first barrier submission instead of the frames before it.
requires: \[fg\] streamline: DLSS_G state frame=\d+ result=0 mode=0\b
